name: settings_read_workspace
description: Read the selected workspace's settings.

name: settings_update_workspace
description: Edit workspace details without replacing unrelated settings.

name: settings_list_members
description: List members and pending invitations in the selected workspace.

name: settings_invite_member
description: Invite one person by email.

name: settings_update_member
description: Change a member's workspace role.

name: settings_remove_member
description: Remove a workspace member.

name: settings_revoke_invitation
description: Revoke a pending workspace invitation.

name: settings_list_workflows
description: Read workflow definitions, owners, steps and project usage.

name: settings_read_workflow
description: Read a workflow before editing it.

name: settings_create_workflow
description: Create a workflow. Creating does not assign it to a project. The server enforces the feature flag and fixed columns.

name: settings_preview_workflow
description: Preview an edit without writing. Return the server's affected-task counts and required status mappings.

name: settings_update_workflow
description: Edit a workflow after previewing the exact change. Preserve status_mapping; do not guess where existing tasks should move.

name: settings_delete_workflow
description: Delete an unused non-default workflow. A workflow in use must not be force-deleted.

name: settings_set_workflow_handoff
description: Set one column's handler, instructions and forward/back destinations. copy_for_project_id edits a project-specific copy.

name: settings_preview_workflow_brief
description: Preview a handler's brief from draft handoff settings, without executing an agent.

name: settings_set_project_workflow
description: Preview or apply a project's workflow. null selects Default. Applying requires a prior preview.

name: settings_list_statuses
description: Read the full status catalog, categories and built-in/custom markers.

name: settings_create_status
description: Create a custom status. Its key and category are immutable after creation.

name: settings_update_status
description: Edit a custom status's display fields. Key and category cannot be changed.

name: settings_reorder_statuses
description: Atomically reorder a category using the dedicated endpoint; never emulate ordering with a series of updates.

name: settings_archive_status
description: Archive a custom status. Built-in or in-use workflow constraints remain enforced by the server.

name: settings_list_wakeups
description: Read workspace-wide system wakeup defaults, instructions and overridden-task counts.

name: settings_update_wakeup
description: Change a workspace system wakeup's enabled flag or instruction; per-task overrides are preserved.

name: settings_list_labels
description: Read issue, agent or Skill labels.

name: settings_create_label
description: Create a workspace label, not a task-label attachment.

name: settings_update_label
description: Edit an existing label definition.

name: settings_delete_label
description: Delete a label definition.

name: settings_list_properties
description: Read typed custom property definitions and select options.

name: settings_create_property
description: Create a typed property definition; type is immutable after creation.

name: settings_update_property
description: Edit a property or archive/restore it. Supply the complete options list when changing config; preserve existing option IDs.

name: settings_list_quick_actions
description: Read the quick-action catalog, including ownership and target visibility.

name: settings_create_quick_action
description: Create a quick-action definition; this does not execute it.

name: settings_update_quick_action
description: Edit or archive a quick action; public/private and target authorization follow server rules.

name: settings_delete_quick_action
description: Delete a quick action.

name: settings_list_mcp_servers
description: Read MCP library metadata only. Server credentials and configuration are write-only.

name: settings_create_mcp_server
description: Add a stdio or HTTP MCP server to the library. This assigns it to no agent; use assign_agent_mcp next.

name: settings_update_mcp_server
description: Replace an MCP library entry's configuration. Agent assignments are kept.

name: settings_rename_mcp_server
description: Rename an MCP library entry without replacing its write-only configuration.

name: settings_delete_mcp_server
description: Remove an MCP library entry. Does not enable inherited external MCPs.

name: settings_list_connections
description: Read code or message-channel connection metadata. Credentials are omitted.

name: settings_disconnect_connection
description: Disconnect a code/message-channel connection; active delivery may stop.

name: settings_update_code_settings
description: Change code-integration flags while retaining unrelated workspace settings. The main-process adapter merges the patch.

name: settings_read_profile
description: Read this account's public profile and account preferences.

name: settings_update_profile
description: Change this account's profile, supported language or IANA timezone (empty timezone restores system detection).

name: settings_read_notifications
description: Read the current user's notification preferences in this workspace.

name: settings_update_notifications
description: Patch only the requested notification groups; unrelated groups are preserved.

name: settings_list_tokens
description: List token metadata, never token values.

name: settings_create_token
description: Create an account token. The resulting secret is displayed to the user in the desktop UI and never returned to the model.

name: settings_revoke_token
description: Revoke an account token.

name: settings_open
description: Open a specific settings tab for OAuth, credentials, or other user interaction. Opening is not a successful configuration change.

name: settings_read_device
description: Read safe device preferences, shortcuts, daemon state and update preferences through the desktop host. Set probe_runtimes=true for an explicit local runtime availability probe.

name: settings_update_device
description: Update explicit device preferences through the same stores as Settings.

name: settings_set_shortcut
description: Set or reset one supported keyboard shortcut. Conflicting or reserved chords are rejected.

name: settings_device_action
description: Request daemon start/stop/restart or check/download/install an app update. Restarting/installing can interrupt work.
